hypothesis: Extracting codec CPU contexts and zsmalloc storage into a page_compress library can preserve existing ZSwap frontend ownership, charging, lifecycle and compressed roundtrip behavior while providing a reusable page/object mechanism for subsequent independent XSwap.

mechanism.claim: ZSwap delegates pool/context and handle store/load/free operations to page_compress while retaining its entry layout, refs, indexes, admission, LRU and memcg policy; one common implementation serves future frontends without per-object wrapper allocations.
mechanism.falsifier: Reject on ownership or accounting drift, non-exercised compression, failed lifecycle/error/configuration coverage, increased per-object/context footprint, or calibrated swap-in/metadata guard regression.

reason: Infrastructure-incomplete: the explicit two-socket NUMA guest passed all functional and kernel-warning gates, but the frozen validity check rejected boot-time TSC instability and HPET fallback. Preserve its original integration_pass=true and run_valid=false, both counted attempts, and the frozen contract. No timing or full correctness acceptance.
